itemList.description: Supplying of .. TR Invertor type split Air conditioners suitable for operation on A/C supply single phase 50 Hz 230 V with hermetically sealed inverter compressor with air cooled condenser, latest R410A / R-32 refrigerant fan motor, start & run capacitors, relay & over load protector internal unit, with one indoor & one outdoor unit The condenser unit will be placed outside the room avoid noise including standard length of suitable size copper tubing covered with nitrile rubber insulation tube. suitable capacity 3 core sheathed/ PVC copper cable and a battery operated wireless remote unit. - 5 star - 1.5 Ton capacity with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Installation charges for 1 to 2 Ton capacity window type Air Conditioner with 50 x 75mm thick teak wood frame of suitable size and allied works complete. with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

A sleek, strong, durable all the features and comofort and fits beautifully into your budgetary as well as aesthetic requirement. High strenth fiber frame, fabric & foam seat, fixed sled base in chrome plated steel (Non-Revolving Chair) with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Nilkamal Revolving Chair with Active bio synchro mechanism Nilkamal (Nilkamal Glory High Back Chair) with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.
